newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE suspends Dec 97 Bund contract pending review.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE suspends Dec 97 Bund contract pending review.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) on Monday said it was suspending its December 1997 Bund futures contract pending a review of legal specifications, particularly criteria for deliverable debt.

"Today's announcement by the Bundesbank outlining the planned issuance for the second quarter of 1997 of Federal German government debt shows a change to the issuance maturity of 10-year Bundesanleihen debt," LIFFE said in a statement.

"In view of this fact the Board has determined that the listing of the December 1997 delivery month of the Bund contract shall be suspended with immediate effect, pending a review of the legal specification and specifically the deliverable criteria," the statement said.
LIFFE said members would be informed of the results of the review and relisting of the month "as soon as practicable".
A LIFFE official told Reuters the review takes into account any change that the Bundesbank may make in issuing policy.
"Only deutschemark debt of maturity between 8-1/2 and 10 years is currently deliverable into the LIFFE Bund contract," the official said.
The Bundesbank, as issuing agent for the German government, said on Monday the government planned some 44 billion marks of debt issuance in the second quarter
There is currently no open interest on the December 1997 Bund contract, the LIFFE official said.
